description: Tamil Nadu’s first Budget under the TVK government focuses on preparing young people for an AI-driven economy, with plans for an AI city, AI university, skill training for lakhs of students and expanded education spending. The state aims to build a future-ready workforce as it targets a $1.5 trillion economy by 2035-36.
